meta.title: type from type checker is different to the type displayed on hover
meta.fix_ref: none named (maintainer: 'This is addressed in pyright 1.1.364')
meta.build_notes: npm pyright@1.1.363 (2024-05-15) and pyright@1.1.364 (2024-05-22); release window from the maintainer's comment.
meta.notes: The report is an R3 inconsistency between two routes (the hover type Never vs the reveal_type type int); comparing a hover text with a diagnostic message is not a relation of the probe library, so the case uses the maintainer's diagnosis ('evaluation-order-dependent results'): a hover that evaluates foo before the checker must not change the checker's answers (R1 query-order).

settings_note: The issue names no settings (pyright VS Code extension 1.1.353 defaults); the session defaults apply.

repro.steps: Open main.py and hover foo in 'reveal_type(foo)' right away, before the server has checked the file (the reporter's editor hovers it). Reported: the hover says Never while reveal_type says int; the maintainer: the type depends on the evaluation order. After the server settles, the diagnostics of main.py (including the reveal_type message) and the hover on foo must equal those of a fresh session that opened the same text without the early hover.
